name: Al-Hadikhia
ability: Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.
wakes: Each night except the first; then each of the up to 3 chosen players wakes in order (1, 2, 3).
interaction: The Al-Hadikhia may choose 3 players (marked 1, 2, 3). Each chosen player is woken in turn, told they were chosen, and silently chooses to live or die; their state is set accordingly (a dead player choosing life is resurrected). If all 3 are then alive, all 3 die. At dawn all players learn who was chosen and which are alive or dead.
drunk_or_poisoned: The ability has no effect: nobody dies or returns to life from it (the Storyteller may still wake the chosen players).

jinxes.text: If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman becomes the Scarlet Woman again.
If the Al-Hadikhia dies by execution, and the Mastermind is alive, the Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 good players tonight: if all 3 choose to live, evil wins. Otherwise, good wins.

rulings.text: If the Al-Hadikhia chooses no one, nothing is announced and nobody dies to them.
A chosen dead player who chooses to live is resurrected and then counts toward the all-live check.
A player who chose death but survived (e.g. protected) still counts as alive for the all-live check.
The Al-Hadikhia may choose evil players, dead players or themself.
At dawn the Storyteller announces which chosen players are alive or dead, even if nothing changed.
